meta.dark_note: pd_offset re-measured 2026-08-28 at 13 dBm with the switch dumped (P0), after the ADC reference moved from AVCC to INTERNAL2V56. It is the one absolute quantity in to_transfer: pd_gain and every optical scale cancel in the per-column normalisation, this does not.
meta.remap_note: 2026-09-22 rewire: vpi/phi0 carried per HEATER onto its new DAC channel(s); bonded pairs share one heater's values. H18/H14/H6 lost their driver and their fits are dropped. pd_gain/pd_offset are per detector and did not move. Pre-rewire file kept as calib.pre-rewire.json. Source: mrunal/board_firmware_v2.md
meta.provenance: vpi/phi0 kept only for channels fitted AFTER the DAC chip-select fix (CS 10 -> 7, 2026-09-22). Earlier runs fitted thermal drift, not fringes, because the DAC was never selected and no heater drew current; those values were accepted at the time and are cleared here.
meta.extrapolated_note: H10 and H13 fit to the Vpi bound: their fringe never turns over in range, so 12.00 V is a LOWER BOUND and the fitted amplitude is the extrapolated full fringe, not an observed swing. The local phase slope is real; the half-wave point is not.
